src.signText: function signText(r) { return pfFit(r.theme.shared ? r.theme.name : r.name, 18); }
src.pfFit: function pfFit(s, max) { s = String(s || '').toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); return [...s].length > max ? [...s].slice(0, max - 1).join('') + '…' : s; }

label.note: r.label (a DOM div) is hidden by the page CSS ("rooms carry painted signs instead"); the sign is canvas art. If a DOM label is ever shown: font -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif 12px/1.3 weight 600, colour rgba(255,255,255,.9), background rgba(20,16,32,.55), padding 3px 9px, radius 999px.

rules.clouds: cloud i is at x = round(((i*131*S + t*(.004+(i%3)*.002)*S) % (W+80*S)) - 60*S) + round(px*.8), y as recorded (cloud sprite i of the bucket: w, y); drawn with the sprite at (x+dx, y+dy); t in ms
rules.gradient: vertical gradient SKY[0] -> SKY[1] over the screen height, then the sunrise glow bands of drawSky
rules.sun: celestial layer is cut at its screen position for the screen size above; sun anchor in .sun

poses.anchors: sprite drawn at (X - ax, Y - ay) where (X, Y) is the point drawClawd was given (the feet, iso of the spot)

timing.waiting: sample i of 6 over 1634 ms: sin(t/260)
timing.cat: walk floor(t/120)%2; sit2 when floor(t/700+seed*7)%6==0; nap Zs (t/1800+seed)%1
timing.dog: walk floor(t/120)%2 (90 when fast); sit2 when floor(t/900+seed*7)%6==0 (wag: floor(t/140)%2==0); bark: sit1/bark floor(t/260)%2 and the text on when floor(t/520)%2==0

proofNote: diff = pixels whose largest channel difference is > 24 against the page's own frame at t=100000 (no agents, no residents, clear weather); house = pixels the house changed against the sky-only frame. The sky is the page's own except at the bucket hours 12 and 20 (sky parts).

light.model: out.rgb = clamp(E.rgb + (F.rgb - E.rgb) * AMB.rgb / FA) per channel; out.a = Ea + (Fa - Ea) * AMB.r / FA (only glass differs in alpha); FA = .5 (see fA). F = the piece cut with AMB = FA,FA,FA, E = with AMB = 0,0,0 (same DARK), same atlas rect in parts-N.png (F) and parts-N-e.png (E). Sprite flag (atlas[id][5]): 0 general, 1 E is black (out = F * AMB: no E sample), 2 constant (E not stored: draw F as is; glows, sky).
light.ambAt: AMB, DARK and SKY for an hour come from ambk by linear interpolation between rows (setTime): AMB, SKY and DARK are mixed with t = (hour - a.hour)/(b.hour - a.hour); row 24 repeats row 0. DARK is ambk[].dark.
light.variantOf: variant i is the first with DARK <= variants[i].hi; every layer list, light list, sign colour pair, lift colour and pose set is cut once per variant at DARK = variants[i].d
light.fWhy: F is cut at AMB = .5, not 1: lit() clamps at 255, so colours with k > 1 clamp in an AMB = 1 cut and come out up to 25/255 too dark at dusk. At .5 nothing clamps; the shader multiplies by AMB / fA (= 2 AMB) and the final clamp is the page's.
light.glows: a light is drawn with blend add at alpha min(1, a + b * DARK) (a, b measured by cutting at DARK and DARK + .004), sprite = unit glow of its colour and radius, at (origin + x, origin + y) - r
light.clock: the clock face is the layer tagged "clock": cut at 12:00 (drawClock draws clockText(d)); the renderer re-draws the digits for another time
light.sunlight: the layer tagged "sunlight" is a floor patch of rgba(255,244,210,k), k = (1 - DARK/.4) * .12 (.05 clouds) while DARK < .4: baked at the variant DARK (error under 3/255)
light.pane: layer kind "pane" is a window glass polygon (pts relative to the room origin, rounded like the page); the renderer draws it live: vertical gradient SKY[0] -> SKY[1] over the polygon bounds, stars when DARK > .55 (rgba(255,255,255,.5+.4*sin(t/1500+i)) for i < width/4 at x = lft + (i*37+seed) % w, y = top + (i*53+seed) % h, size S), then a 3 px reflection rgba(255,255,255,.18) at lft + .15*w. SKY is the sky colours of the hour (a uniform), not AMB-linear.

nonLinear.handle: alpha mixes with AMB[0] via Fa/Ea (above); colour is constant; the remaining quadratic term is under 6/255

nonLinear.what: emi(c, .7 + .3 * AMB[0]) and similar: brightness follows AMB[0] on every channel
nonLinear.handle: F/E interpolation uses AMB[c] per channel; error is (AMB[c] - AMB[0]) * .3 * c, under 12/255 at dusk, on small props

nonLinear.what: sign colour DARK > .3 ? emi(c, k * (1 - DARK * .3)) : lit(c, k)
nonLinear.handle: sign colours are cut per variant as (F, E) pairs at the variant DARK; thresholds .7 .8 .9 keep the DARK factor within 4/255
baked per variant; layer tagged sunlight; error under 3/255

nonLinear.what: glow alpha .06 + .26 * DARK, (.1 + .25 * DARK) * e, .1 + .3 * DARK...
nonLinear.handle: uniform: a + b * DARK per light in the manifest

nonLinear.what: pane(): SKY[0]/SKY[1] gradient and stars (DARK > .55) over time
nonLinear.handle: drawn by the renderer from the SKY and DARK uniforms (layer kind pane)

nonLinear.what: lit() truncates (| 0) and clamps at 255; F is cut at AMB = 1 so a colour with k > 1 clamps in F
nonLinear.handle: error is the clamped excess times AMB, under 4/255

nonLinear.what: sky and backdrop mix SKY[1] into colours (haze), alpha .82 - DARK * .4
nonLinear.handle: not part of any room piece: the sky is cut per AMBK bucket (sky.buckets), the renderer interpolates or owns it

rules.bridge: Bridges are exported as concrete configurations (village.links, plan prefix of 13 links, valid for 0..14 projects). Rules for a renderer that wants to repeat them: planks n = Math.max(3, Math.round((s1 - s0) / .3)), plank colour ["#c48c58","#b88250","#cc965e"][(i*2 + (i>>2)) % 3], seam line at each plank i>0 in #7a4a2a, nail on odd i; posts m = Math.max(1, Math.round((s1 - s0 - .3) / 1.0)) at s0+.15+(s1-s0-.3)*i/m, rope 6 segments per span with sag 6.6 - sin(u*PI)*1.6; lanterns at s0+.15 and s1-.15 (lit when DARK > .3, glow 20*S #ffc870). Source: room/index.html drawLink.
rules.stair: Stairs are concrete (13 steps, W=.5, rope posts every 3rd step, lantern at the foot); the swing (L.lift) is only exported down/up. Source: room/index.html drawStair.
rules.lift: The lift is exported per floor count (3 for 0 projects, 4 for >=1): shaft slices plus cage; pulleys are static. Source: room/index.html drawLifts.

limits: dynamic items frozen at t=100000, the clock at 12:00
stair swing only down/up, pulleys static
sky cut for a 2304x1490 canvas at the AMBK bucket hours; other sizes and hours need the page sky / the renderer's own formulas

note.sprites: [page, x, y, w, h, flag] in the F page parts-N.png; the E page parts-N-e.png has the same rect (flag 0 and 1 only)
